backgrounds.name: the flow round a spinning body
backgrounds.description: The flow round a body of 4 million solar masses spinning at half the most a black hole can: space falls straight in, as in Part 1, and the body's rotation adds a swirl round it, 2GJ x r/c^2 r^3, anticlockwise here, the way the body spins. It falls off as 1/r^2, much faster than the inflow, so only close in does it show. Arrows show the flow u; the colour its speed.
